title: Choosing the Protection Source for a Personal Checking Account
content:
The protection source for a Personal Checking account is the first of the owner's own savings accounts, tried in the order set below, whose usable cover reaches the cover a source must provide; where no savings account reaches it, no protection source is named.

**The cover a source must provide** is the full cover requirement of 25000.00.

**The cover reserve** is the full cover reserve of 13000.00.

**The usable cover** of a savings account is the minimum cover share of 0.02 of its balance, less the cover reserve, and never below zero.

**The order candidates are tried in** is the statement savings account first and the premier money market account second, both held under Savings & Money Market Accounts.

**Worked example on hypothetical inputs.** An owner holds a statement savings account of 40000.00 and a premier money market account of 30000.00.

| Quantity | Hypothetical figure |
|---|---|
| Minimum cover share of the statement savings balance | 800.00 |
| Less the cover reserve, held at no less than zero | 0.00 |
| Minimum cover share of the premier money market balance | 600.00 |
| Less the cover reserve, held at no less than zero | 0.00 |
| Cover a source must provide | 25000.00 |
| First candidate tried, the statement savings account | Its usable cover does not reach the requirement |
| Second candidate tried, the premier money market account | Its usable cover does not reach the requirement |
| Protection source | None is named |

The share is taken on the balance first and the reserve is subtracted afterwards, so a balance whose share falls below the reserve yields a usable cover of 0.00 rather than a negative figure.
